entities.summary: Yifat Kariv is an Israeli politician and social worker. She served as a member of the Knesset for Yesh Atid between 2013 and 2015. Lecturer and expert in Jewish mental health and the development of personal and community healing processes. Founder of "The Work of the Heart," a healing community for women based on the teachings of the Mirrors, Hasidic, and the inner workings of the Torah.
